method.gridRule: 1m absolute + relative (warming fallback per P4); 1 or 2 absolute natural 5m confirmations; confirmRelative disabled to preserve bar axis
method.fees: not estimated; no positions, execution costs, impermanent loss, or LP net return
method.discovery: RPC coverage evidence only; each cohort carries its saved input mode; current-registry selection is retrospective-cohort
method.reactionDelaySemantics: delay=0 includes the emission minute, potentially preceding the actual emission second; delay>=1 is the primary conservative comparison
method.externalComparison: GMGN token-level USD estimates and chain pool-specific activity differ in scope, aggregation and valuation time; no forced matching
method.namedCases: regression selection only; never a population denominator
